description.narrative: The project will provide the population in the municipalities of Dharan, Janakpur, Nepalgunj, and Siddharthanagar with better access to municipal infrastructure and services in a socially inclusive manner. In accordance with the priorities of each municipality, integrated urban environmental improvements, including drainage systems, solid waste management (SWM) facilities, and urban roads, will be implemented in Janakpur, Nepalgunj, and Siddharthanagar municipalities. A water supply development subproject will be implemented in Dharan municipality. The project will also undertake community development programs (CDPs), focusing primarily on poverty pockets in the municipalities and communities that may not benefit directly from major infrastructure improvement subprojects. Gender equality and social inclusion (GESI) will be mainstreamed in all subprojects in the municipalities, and the capacity to address GESI in the Ministry of Physical Planning and Works (MPPW) will be strengthened by establishing an appropriate institutional structure and mechanisms for GESI mainstreaming.

(iii) Solid waste management: Household collection coverage increased to 90%, from 40% in Janakpur, 70% in Nepalgunj, and 56% in Siddharthanagar in 2010. Achievement: 10 Progress/Status: The ISWM subproject at Nepalgunj is in operation from May 2019. Assessment of household collection coverage is in progress and result reflected in government PCR. Janakpur ISWM subproject was dropped and Siddhrathnagar ISWM contract terminated due to inaccessibility to the sites. Data Source: Reports issued by municipalities and MOUD.

(ii) Water supply. Water generation in Dharan increased from 10.9 million liters per day to 23.0 million liters per day in the dry season, coverage of services increased from 83% to 95%, and hours of supply increased from 4 to 16 per day. Achievement: 95 Progress/Status: Current generation is 19.72 MLD including 10.52 MLD from existing NWSC systems thereby increasing coverage of water supply to 95%. Out of the 5 water supply subsystems under the project, the fully operational Railway and Pindeshwor subsystems are supplying 16 hours of water per day. Data Source: Reports issued by DWSMB and MOUD

(i) Stormwater drainage. Flooding duration in heavy rains decreased in 95% of the town from (i) 5 hours to less than an hour in Janakpur, (ii) 8 days to 3 hours in Nepalgunj, and (iii) 5 hours to less than an hour in Siddharthanagar. Achievement: Y Progress/Status: The EA through its assessment reported that flooding duration has been decreased to less than an hour in Siddharthanagar, Nepalgunj and Janakpur municipalities, which is higher than expected. Data Source: Reports issued by municipalities and MOUD Base year: 2011 Baseline value: N
